ai_summary: Aadhar Housing Finance Limited has appointed Mr. Nikhil Goyal, a Managing Director at Blackstone Advisors India Private Limited, as an Additional Director, effective August 12, 2026, with shareholder approval pending for his role as a Non-Executive Nominee Director of the Promoter Company. This appointment, featuring a highly experienced financial services and private equity professional, materially strengthens the board's strategic oversight and aligns with the interests of the promoter. No red flags are apparent, and the appointment seems to be a standard board augmentation by a well-qualified individual.
